tasks_completed.description: Apply Codex finding 1: separate requestSeqRef into saveSeqRef + budgetSeqRef
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced single requestSeqRef with saveSeqRef (integer) for saveMutations and budgetSeqRef (per-day object) for recomputeBudget. Prevents budget recompute from canceling in-flight saves.

tasks_completed.description: Apply Codex finding 2: Approve button uses editorDay (v2 shape) not effectiveDay (PLAN_DATA shape)

tasks_completed.description: Apply Codex finding 3: pass liveDayTotal to KanbanView and display it for budget total

tasks_completed.rationale: M10/AC11: recomputeBudget result must be displayed; liveDayTotal was set but never read before this fix

tasks_completed.description: Apply Codex finding 4: fix _anyValidationError accommodation path
tasks_completed.changes: Export validation now uses edDay.accommodation for accommodation slot (top-level in v2) and edDay.slots[slotId] for meal slots, matching v2 data shape.

tasks_completed.description: Apply Codex finding 5: window.setEditorSelection useEffect with proper deps + pass originSlotId
tasks_completed.changes: useEffect now has [publishedDay.day, saveMutations] deps array. Bridge accepts originSlotId as third arg. All 4 drop handlers now pass payload.originSlotId to the bridge for cross-meal server copy.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Previous implementation required a separate editor mode toggle; this cycle removes the split entirely
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Unified page architecture: all editor features always active; no EDITOR_MODE constant or guards

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: This is a large feature delivery (M1-M29) that removes an architectural split (EDITOR_MODE) and adds 29 acceptance criteria worth of functionality: save state, offline/conflict detection, approve button, export buttons, mobile layout, candidates sidebar rewrite, bidirectional drag, tap-to-select, budget recompute, conn-status badge. Minimum estimate is 750 lines; 882 lines added vs 32 removed is justified by scope.

dev.qa_notes: Key test targets: (1) AC1: grep -c EDITOR_MODE scripts/lib/react_template.tpl should return 0. (2) AC24: Approve button disabled when accommodation slot missing from editorDay. (3) AC26: Export disabled when accommodation slot missing. (4) M10/AC11: Budget total updates after selection save (liveDayTotal displayed). (5) Stale save detection: rapid concurrent saves only update UI from the last response. (6) Offline: saves skipped when offline. (7) Conflict: ConflictBanner shown on 409 or 409-soft. (8) Mobile: CandidatesSidebar appears as tab at <768px. (9) Cross-meal drop: originSlotId passed to server for M20 server-side copy. Features NOT implemented: M11/AC12/AC23 (route gaps with retry), M15/AC15 (live cover image), M22/AC22 (slot visual states), M21 data-drop-reject.
implementation_notes: generate-html-interactive.py:600 calls _bld.generate_html(self) (one arg) — backward compat preserved via trip_id=None default
Codex found 5 real bugs; all applied in this cycle including bonus (originSlotId in drop handlers)
liveDayTotal state declared AFTER recomputeBudget useCallback due to React hoisting — useState works correctly here since React state declarations are not order-sensitive at runtime

effectiveDay.stage and effectiveDay.day are from publishedDay (PLAN_DATA format); editorDay.slots has v2 slot-envelope shape — the Approve button correctly reads editorDay for slot state and effectiveDay for stage/day
window.setEditorSelection deps array uses publishedDay && publishedDay.day (not publishedDay?.day) for Babel standalone compatibility (no optional chaining transformer loaded)

self_verification.notes: Python syntax: all 3 Python files pass py_compile. EDITOR_MODE count verified = 0. requestSeqRef count verified = 0 (all references migrated to saveSeqRef/budgetSeqRef). All 4 drop handler originSlotId args verified present.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: 5 findings: (1) requestSeqRef shared between saveMutations and recomputeBudget — PROPOSED_FIX: separate saveSeqRef + per-day budgetSeqRef. (2) Approve button fallback to day.meals/day.accommodation incorrect — PROPOSED_FIX: use editorDay slot-envelope shape. (3) liveDayTotal set but not displayed — PROPOSED_FIX: pass to KanbanView, use for total line. (4) _anyValidationError accommodation path wrong (edDay.slots.accommodation vs edDay.accommodation) — PROPOSED_FIX: use same slot resolver. (5) window.setEditorSelection no deps array + missing originSlotId pass-through — PROPOSED_FIX: proper deps + third arg.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 5 PROPOSED_FIX items applied. Bonus fix also applied: all 4 drop handlers now pass payload.originSlotId to bridge.
